title: Medisee and Stone Kebabs
description: A simple and flavorful Indian-inspired recipe featuring medisee and stone. The medisee adds a sweet and nutty flavor, while the stone provides a crunchy texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the medisee into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Add the stone, coconut oil, lemon juice, cumin powder, coriander powder, and salt to the bowl with the medisee.
Thread the medisee mixture onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the medisee is tender and the stone is crispy.
